correctness.rationale: The inverse bidiagonal identity and singular reciprocal relation are exact. Rank perturbation of at most L-1 changes singular distribution functions by at most (L-1)/n; frozen-block perturbation costs at most 2m/n in operator norm. Exact Dirichlet–Neumann tridiagonal eigenvalues give 2sin((2k-1)pi/(4l+2)). Angle-cell and position couplings cost at most pi L/n and 2m/n. The sum [2(L-1)+pi L+4m]/n is <12/sqrt(n) for n>=16, while the diameter of common support handles n<16. CDF differentiation and M^2-Lipschitz clipping establish all remaining conclusions. Diagnostic standard-library Sturm bisection was replayed.
